# Rhizomatics

> Open source software for Home Assistant, MQTT, Docker self-hosting and marine SignalK integrations.

Rhizomatics is an open source organisation publishing free, source-available tools that
integrate with Home Assistant, MQTT brokers, Docker, and the SignalK marine data standard. All
projects are hosted on GitHub at https://github.com/rhizomatics.

## Overview

- [Home](<https://www.rhizomatics.org.uk/index.md>): Introduction to Rhizomatics and its projects

## Projects

- [Home Automation](<https://www.rhizomatics.org.uk/home-automation/index.md>): Home Assistant, MQTT and Docker self-hosting projects: AutoArm, Supernotify, Updates2MQTT, anpr2mqtt, Remote Logger
- [Sailing](<https://www.rhizomatics.org.uk/sailing/index.md>): SignalK plugins and tools, and the Boat Tech Directory of marine hardware, software and resources
